analysis.title: GS Consumer: 6 Stocks in Focus
key_insights: RCL reported the second solid cruise print in a month (following CCL on 9/29). The stock is expected to stay in favor into accelerating yields for 4Q and 2027.
RCL 3Q net yield was +0.6%. RCL remains committed to an acceleration into the mid-4% range in 4Q, and still says it can hit its weighted 4Q guide, which has been the debate all year.
RCL says it will have a $20 handle on 2027 EPS (consensus $20.32, +14% implied growth) and that bookings and rates are ahead of historical levels.

HLT shares are -4% pre-market and the GS trading desk is better to sell early. Investors cite a high bar after a move from $300 to $350 over the last month, plus small issues on 3Q flow-through and the 4Q guide.

HLT flow-through to the bottom line was underwhelming for a second straight quarter, with single-digit EBITDA growth again. US RevPAR was +7% in 3Q, which points to a solid consumer, and 4Q is guided a little below that.
KO had another solid quarter, with best-in-class organic revenue growth (+7%) and 170 bps of gross margin upside. North America was +3% vs consensus +4%, and LatAm drove a bulk of the upside.

KO was at an all-time high until Thursday of last week. Investors are asking about valuation (27x) and the upside at these levels, and KO price action is a read-through for other high-bar staples names.
ROST rose on an upgrade, but there are numerous comments about slowing data in off-price. Investors have the most confidence in a ROST 3Q beat, with more questions around BURL's trends.
OLLI has lagged the last 2 weeks (stock -$10) on feedback about slower data to end 3Q. Earlier in the quarter investors were looking for clear upside to 3Q SSS consensus.

DG fell hard midday on headlines that the FTC sued it for alleged deceptive pricing. Investors say such headlines have not mattered much for stocks in the past, and the space was weak and a big underperformer, so it did not take much to push names down. Upside to 3Q is expected, and the question is durability of recent top-line outperformance.

earnings_insights: RCL 3Q (reported 10/27): net yield +0.6%. Management commits to an acceleration into the mid-4% range in 4Q and says 2027 EPS will have a $20 handle. Consensus 2027 EPS is $20.32 (+14% implied growth).
HLT 3Q (reported 10/27): US RevPAR +7%, single-digit EBITDA growth for the second straight quarter, 4Q RevPAR guided a little below 3Q. Shares -4% pre-market.
KO 3Q (reported 10/27): organic revenue +7%, 170 bps of gross margin upside, North America +3% vs consensus +4%. LatAm drove a bulk of the upside.
ROST and OLLI: 3Q not yet reported. Investors look for a ROST beat and clear upside to OLLI 3Q SSS consensus. BURL trends are the bigger question.
